install: git submodule update --init --recursive && ([ -x "$HOME/.foundry/bin/forge" ] || (curl -fsSL https://foundry.paradigm.xyz | bash && "$HOME/.foundry/bin/foundryup")) && (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile || (mv pnpm-lock.yaml /tmp/pnpm-lock.orig && pnpm install && mv /tmp/pnpm-lock.orig pnpm-lock.yaml)) && ([ -f .env ] || printf 'SRC_CHAIN_RPC=https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com\nDST_CHAIN_RPC=https://bsc-rpc.publicnode.com\n' > .env) && PATH="$HOME/.foundry/bin:$PATH" forge build
